SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model for software engineering, knowledge work and cyber defense, with a 1M-token output limit. It is rolling out first to cyber defenders.

SIGNALS.name: Peter McCrory
SIGNALS.summary: Announces new research from colleagues exploring what work robots can do today and what that could mean for the structure of the economy in the coming years.

SIGNALS.name: Demis Hassabis
SIGNALS.summary: Hassabis says Google DeepMind is bringing SynthID watermarking to biology so AI-generated proteins can be tagged, and is open-sourcing the SynthID Bio tools. The work is published in Nature.

SIGNALS.name: Pushmeet Kohli
SIGNALS.summary: Pushmeet Kohli says his Google DeepMind team synthesized AI-designed proteins that are functional and carry a watermark, a proof of concept for tracing AI-made biology.

SIGNALS.name: Benzinga
SIGNALS.summary: Reports that President Trump hosted AI executives at the White House to sign a voluntary safety agreement, the White House Accord on Super Intelligence, focused on oversight of advanced systems.

SIGNALS.name: Financial Times
SIGNALS.summary: The Financial Times reports that AI voice start-up ElevenLabs has doubled its valuation to $22bn.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, which it says brings near GPT-6 Astra intelligence at about a fifth of Astra's price.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI introduced dots, agents powered by GPT-6 Astra that can handle simple tasks like booking a table as well as larger jobs.

SIGNALS.name: Artificial Analysis
SIGNALS.summary: Artificial Analysis says Claude Sonnet 5.5 scores 56 on its Intelligence Index, two points behind Opus 5.5 at max effort, with the highest output tokens per task it has recorded.
